Headline: Structural - Ormiston Academies Trust (State), National
Info: Ormiston Academies Trust has announced the transfer of two of its schools to another trust, a structural change driven by the belief that it is in the best interests of the schools and their pupils.

Headline: Financial - Mainstream Schools (State), National
Info: At least one in five councils has ruled out taking part in a landmark government trial to transfer high-needs funding directly into mainstream school budgets, citing significant financial risks.
